ingredients: 4 eggs, separated and at room temperature
¼ cup (½ stick/125 g) unsalted butter, melted
¼ tsp freshly ground black pepper
½ cup (60 g) grated mozzarella cheese
steps: Cook pasta in a gallon of salted boiling water until al dente. Drain, rinse with cold water and set aside.
Combine ricotta, egg yolks, butter, salt, pepper, garlic, parsley and tomato paste. Fold in pasta.
Beat egg whites with cream of tartar in a spotlessly clean metal bowl to stiff peaks. Gently fold into pasta mixture.
Pour into a parchment-lined high-sided roasting pan. Sprinkle with mozzarella, cover with foil and bake in the center of the oven for 15 minutes.
Remove foil and lower oven to 350°F (175°C). Bake another 30 minutes until browned and bubbly.
Plate portions, garnish with basil and serve warm.
